title: anyantudre/moore-image-lexicon
description:
Mooré image lexicon
	

This dataset has 4,108 photos taken from three Mooré dictionaries. Each photo comes with the Mooré word and its French and English glosses. For 162 test photos there are also three wrong options for multiple-choice questions and a label that says whether the thing is local to West Africa. A second set of 222 household photos from Dollar Street is in household_set/.
I built the dataset to test how small vision-language models handle West African objects in… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/anyantudre/moore-image-lexicon.
